title: 2 days in Paris
tips: Book Eiffel Tower tickets in advance to skip long lines.
Carry a small prayer mat or scarf for mosque visits.
Visit Musée du quai Branly early to avoid crowds.
Try a croissant at a local bakery before the museum opens.
summary: A family-friendly two-day itinerary in Paris that blends iconic sights, art experiences, and prayer-friendly stops around the children's interests in Studio Ghibli, the Little Prince, and art.
